The `sha256sums` is present and not set to `'SKIP'`, so there is no issue with source verification at this stage. Even if it were `SKIP`, that would not make this gate unsafe, as checksum skipping is not an execution risk during `--printsrcinfo`.

There is no evidence of obfuscated code, unauthorized network calls, or malicious payloads executed at parse time. All constructs are consistent with standard PKGBUILD practices.
</details>
